alias-of:place_954>golgotha_487@33a83b.note: Matthew explains that Golgotha is 'a place of a skull' (27.33).

date:bearing-cross-to-golgotha@22ede5.note: Set in Passover week (26.2), on the crucifixion day (27.32). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:crucifixion-and-burial@22ede5.note: Darkness from the sixth to the ninth hour (27.45), burial at evening (27.57). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:debates-in-the-temple@22ede5.note: Set in the week that began with the entry into Jerusalem (21.1, 21.23). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:fig-tree-cursed@22ede5.note: Set on the morning he returned to the city, in the week of the entry (21.1, 21.18). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:healing-a-boy-with-a-demon@2c186f.note: Set after the transfiguration, which came 'after six days' (17.1, 17.14). No year is given. The year 29 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:healing-blind-bartimaeus@22ede5.note: Set on the road up to Jerusalem before Passover (20.17, 20.29). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:holy-week@22ede5.note: The week from the entry into Jerusalem (21.1) to Passover in two days (26.2). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:jesus-teaches-in-perea@22ede5.note: Set beyond Jordan before the journey up to Jerusalem (19.1, 20.17). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:jewish-trials@22ede5.note: Night arrest and trial before the Passover (26.2, 26.57). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:judas-plans-betrayal@22ede5.note: Set after the Bethany anointing and two days before Passover (26.2, 26.14). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:judas-suicide@22ede5.note: Set on the morning Jesus is condemned (27.1, 27.5). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:olivet-discourse@22ede5.note: Given on the Mount of Olives, before the 'after two days' Passover statement (24.3, 26.2). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:prayer-and-betrayal-in-gethsemane@2.note: Set on the night after the Last Supper (26.20, 26.36). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:resurrection-and-ascension@22ede5.note: Set at dawn on the first day of the week (28.1). Matthew gives no ascension and no year. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:roman-trials@22ede5.note: Set on the morning after the night arrest, when they delivered him to Pilate (27.1, 27.2). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:sanhedrin-conspiracy@22ede5.note: Chief priests assemble before the feast, two days before Passover (26.2, 26.3). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:second-foretelling-of-death-and-res.note: Given while they abode in Galilee (17.22). No year is given. The year 29 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:tax-coin-in-a-fish-s-mouth@2c186f.note: Set in Galilee after the second foretelling, when they came to Capernaum (17.22, 17.24). No year is given. The year 29 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:teaching-by-the-fig-tree@22ede5.note: Set on the morning after the entry, when the fig tree withered (21.18, 21.21). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:teachings-on-humility-temptation-re.note: Set 'at the same time' after the Capernaum episode (17.24, 18.1). No year is given. The year 29 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:temple-cleansed@22ede5.note: Set on entering Jerusalem, in the week before Passover (21.1, 21.12). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:the-last-supper@22ede5.note: Set on the first day of unleavened bread, two days before Passover (26.2, 26.17). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:the-transfiguation@2c186f.note: Dated only as 'after six days' (17.1), from an unstated starting point. No year is given. The year 29 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

date:triumphal-entry@22ede5.note: Set as they drew near Jerusalem (21.1), days before Passover (26.2). No year is given. The year 30 (AD) depends on outside chronology.

near:gethsemane_462>jerusalem_636@534bea.note: Gethsemane is reached from the Mount of Olives (26.30, 26.36), which they reached as they drew near Jerusalem (21.1). Distance is not stated.

occurred-at:bearing-cross-to-golgotha>go.note: Simon is made to carry the cross as they came out (27.32). Only after that do they come to Golgotha (27.33).

occurred-at:crucifixion-and-burial>golgo.note: The crucifixion is at Golgotha (27.33, 27.35). The text does not place Joseph's tomb (27.60) at Golgotha.

occurred-at:debates-in-the-temple>jerusa.note: Jesus came into Jerusalem, then into the temple, where the chief priests questioned him (21.10, 21.23).

occurred-at:holy-week>jerusalem_636@29a3.note: Entry and temple teaching are in Jerusalem (21.10), but the week also includes Bethany (21.17) and the Mount of Olives (24.3).

occurred-at:jewish-trials>jerusalem_636@.note: The trial is at the high priest's palace (26.3, 26.57). No city is named there; Jerusalem is inferred from the wider story.

occurred-at:judas-suicide>jerusalem_636@.note: He threw the silver down in the temple (27.5), which Matthew reaches after coming into Jerusalem (21.10). The place of hanging is not named.

occurred-at:sanhedrin-conspiracy>jerusal.note: The chief priests and elders meet at the high priest's palace (26.3). No city is named; Jerusalem is inferred from the wider story.

occurred-at:the-last-supper>jerusalem_63.note: They are sent into 'the city' for the Passover (26.18), the Jerusalem he entered (21.10).

occurred-at:triumphal-entry>jerusalem_63.note: They drew near Jerusalem (21.1); when he was come into Jerusalem, the whole city was moved (21.10).

participated-in:barabbas_399>roman-trial.note: Barabbas is the prisoner set against Jesus (27.16), and Pilate releases him during the trial (27.26).

participated-in:caiaphas_532>sanhedrin-c.note: The meeting is at Caiaphas's palace (26.3), but the text does not say he took part in the plot (26.4).

participated-in:james_717>the-transfigua.note: James, brother of John, is one of the three taken up the mountain (17.1) and touched by Jesus (17.7).

participated-in:jesus_905>healing-a-boy-.note: Jesus rebukes the devil, and the child is cured from that very hour (17.18).

participated-in:jesus_905>healing-blind-.note: Jesus stands still, calls the blind men, and touches their eyes; they receive sight (20.32, 20.34).

participated-in:jesus_905>judas-suicide@.note: Judas acts alone: he returns the silver and hangs himself (27.3, 27.5). Jesus is absent; only his price is named (27.9).

participated-in:jesus_905>resurrection-a.note: Jesus is risen (28.6) and meets the women (28.9). Matthew has no ascension.

participated-in:jesus_905>tax-coin-in-a-.note: Jesus asks Peter about the tribute (17.25), then tells him to take the coin from the fish (17.27).

participated-in:jesus_905>teachings-on-h.note: Jesus sets a little child in the midst and teaches humility (18.2, 18.3).

participated-in:jesus_905>the-last-suppe.note: He sits down with the twelve (26.20) and gives the bread and the cup (26.26, 26.27).

participated-in:john_1677>the-transfigua.note: John, brother of James, is taken up with the other two (17.1) and sees only Jesus with them (17.8).

participated-in:joseph_1716>crucifixion-.note: Joseph of Arimathaea begs the body from Pilate (27.58) and lays it in his own new tomb (27.60).

participated-in:mary_1940>crucifixion-an.note: Watches from afar (27.55, 27.56) and sits facing the tomb (27.61). The text says Mary, mother of James and Joses, not wife of Cleophas.

participated-in:mary_1940>resurrection-a.note: 'The other Mary' comes to the tomb and meets Jesus (28.1, 28.9). The text does not call her the wife of Cleophas.

participated-in:mary_1943>crucifixion-an.note: Watches from afar (27.55, 27.56) and sits facing the tomb (27.61). The text does not say she acts in the crucifixion or burial.

participated-in:mother_of_zebedees_child.note: Among the women watching from afar (27.55, 27.56). The text does not say she acts in the crucifixion or burial.

participated-in:peter_2745>jewish-trials.note: Peter is in the high priest's palace (26.58) and denies Jesus there (26.69, 26.70), but the trial itself does not involve him.

participated-in:peter_2745>prayer-and-be.note: Jesus takes Peter to Gethsemane (26.37) and speaks to him about watching (26.40).

participated-in:peter_2745>tax-coin-in-a.note: The tribute collectors come to Peter (17.24), and Jesus tells him to take the coin from the fish (17.27).

participated-in:peter_2745>the-transfigu.note: Peter is taken up with Jesus (17.1) and answers him, offering three tabernacles (17.4).
